_comment: Curated industry/actor -> high-relevance ATT&CK technique profiles for
threat-informed gap weighting (MITRE Phase 11). DETERMINISTIC input to
ranking.build_threat_profile — never touches coverage %, only lifts
profile-relevant gaps above equal-tier peers in the ranked gap list.
Every technique ID must resolve 'ok' against the pinned attack.json
(enforced by test_mitre_threat_profile.py). Industry keys are the
LOWERCASE of the /mitre/new wizard's INDUSTRIES values; aliases fold
related wizard options onto one profile. Actor keys are display names
Sources: MITRE ATT&CK Groups pages (G-codes cited per actor), Verizon
AA23-325A LockBit, AA23-320A Scattered Spider, AA24-038A Volt Typhoon),
Mandiant M-Trends 2025, HHS HC3 healthcare sector reports, FS-ISAC
annual report, Dragos OT/ICS Year in Review 2025.
Curation rule: 8-12 techniques per entry, only behaviors repeatedly
attributed in public reporting — high-confidence over exhaustive.

financial services.label: Financial Services
financial services.sources: FS-ISAC annual report; Verizon DBIR 2025 (finance: phishing, stolen creds, web-app attacks); CISA #StopRansomware

healthcare.label: Healthcare
healthcare.sources: HHS HC3 sector alerts (ransomware-dominant); CISA #StopRansomware; DBIR 2025 healthcare snapshot

manufacturing.label: Manufacturing
manufacturing.sources: Dragos OT/ICS Year in Review 2025 (manufacturing most-targeted); IBM X-Force 2025; CISA #StopRansomware

energy & utilities.label: Energy & Utilities
energy & utilities.sources: CISA AA24-038A (Volt Typhoon pre-positioning); Dragos 2025; E-ISAC reporting

technology.label: Technology
technology.sources: Mandiant M-Trends 2025 (identity/cloud + supply chain against tech/SaaS); CISA AA23-320A

telecommunications.label: Telecommunications
telecommunications.sources: M-Trends 2025 (telecom espionage: edge-device exploitation, web shells); CISA Salt-Typhoon-related advisories

retail & e-commerce.label: Retail & E-commerce
retail & e-commerce.sources: DBIR 2025 retail snapshot (web-app attacks, stolen creds, Magecart-style skimming)

government & public sector.label: Government & Public Sector
government & public sector.sources: MITRE ATT&CK Groups (APT28/29 targeting of government); CISA nation-state advisories; DBIR 2025 public-sector snapshot

education.label: Education
education.sources: CISA #StopRansomware (education advisories); DBIR 2025 education snapshot (phishing, password spraying)

FIN7.note: Financially motivated; phishing-to-backdoor intrusions, later ransomware affiliations.

Lazarus Group.note: DPRK-attributed; financial theft + espionage, trojanized installers.

APT28.note: GRU-attributed; credential harvesting, password spraying, phishing.

APT41.note: Dual espionage + financially motivated; web-facing app exploitation, web shells.

Sandworm Team.note: GRU-attributed; destructive operations against energy/critical infrastructure.

Volt Typhoon.note: PRC-attributed; living-off-the-land pre-positioning in critical infrastructure (CISA AA24-038A).

Scattered Spider.note: Help-desk social engineering, MFA fatigue, RMM abuse, data-theft extortion (CISA AA23-320A).

LockBit affiliates.note: RaaS affiliates per CISA AA23-325A; commodity intrusion to encryption/exfiltration.
